layeringNote: Python Oracle layering (T007 P2-1 / T011 P2-6, accepted as-is): the Python Geometry Oracle reuses the same-side Python Modes Oracle (modes_oracle.py) as its replay/validation layer, and the Python BFS Oracle reuses the same-side Python Modes/Events/Geometry Oracles for single-step transitions and rectangle geometry, exactly as the TypeScript geometry evaluator reuses the same-side modes.ts and the TypeScript BFS reuses the same-side geometry-eval.ts / events.ts. The BFS search itself (alphabet, queue order, dedup key, bounds, fail-closed limits) is implemented independently on each side. There is zero shared code and zero calling between the TypeScript side and the Python side — the two sides share only read-only fixtures, field names and the canonical-JSON definition — so the parity remains a genuine cross-check. No ignore list exists.
